parameters.name: Day
parameters.description:
The date to query, in UTC+8. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

> Only data from the previous month or earlier can be queried.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the resource.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Only **cbwp** is supported, which indicates Internet Shared Bandwidth.
